body:
## Summary

- Adds `items.md`: plain-text Q/A input file with support for topic, ref, date, and multi-line fields; pre-populated with the three sample items from the issue
- Adds `parse_items.py`: parses `items.md` into structured JSON; supports `--topic` filter and `--list-topics`
- Adds `quiz.py`: interactive self-grading quiz (`y/n` scoring) and `--list` view grouped by topic; imports from `parse_items`
- Adds `export_anki.py`: exports items to a tab-separated TSV for direct Anki import (Front | Back | Tags)
- Updates README with a **Learning Tools** section covering usage and the `items.md` format

## Test plan

- [ ] `python3 parse_items.py` returns all three items as JSON
- [ ] `python3 parse_items.py --list-topics` prints `architectures` and `microbiome`
- [ ] `python3 parse_items.py --topic architectures` returns only the two architecture items
- [ ] `python3 quiz.py --list` shows items grouped by topic
- [ ] `python3 export_anki.py` outputs three tab-separated lines with correct fields
- [ ] Add a new item to `items.md` and confirm all scripts pick it up

Closes #3
title: Add learning tools: items.md, parser, quiz, and Anki export
